scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:all: npm run build && npx cap sync && bash harmonyos/sync-web-resources.sh
scripts.build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android-debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
